The most critical defect is the fusion of the fourth rabbit into the central rabbit's torso; an eye and ear emerge directly from the chest fur without a connecting neck or body, violating basic anatomy. Additionally, the sheep exhibits a texture anomaly (reddish smudge near the eye) and boundary melting where paws blend indistinctly into the grass. While the painterly style masks some issues, the fusion artifact is a fundamental generation failure.
